SisTer Reflexa — recursive verification contamination

Observed after MVP0-E001R-REV1 assessment.
Cause: T_ADV4 invoked verify_mvp0.sh, which invoked build.sh,
which invoked CTest, which invoked T_ADV4 recursively.

These directories were untracked artifacts generated by the defective test.
They are recorded here before cleanup and are not promoted as valid verification runs.
